entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Things are very lively here!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I wonder if people are drawn by[n]the fact that this place is at[n]the forefront of fashion.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Fashion, food, and what else...?[n]Let's try walking around! We may[n]find something interesting!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Crêpes, pancakes, and parfaits![n]Everything was so delicious...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I was actually hesitant to[n]eat any of them because of[n]how cute they were.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: And then there were the smiles[n]of the other customers... Just[n]seeing that made me happy.
I think I understand.
Why?
You were smiling too.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Oh, you do?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Right, of course you do... The[n]smiles of others are the ultimate[n]reward for allies of justice.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Don't you think it's a[n]wonderful feeling seeing[n]people smile at your work?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I would expect you to[n]understand, given your work[n]with the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Huh? I didn't notice...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Either way, being able to make[n]customers smile is lovely.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Those who work want to see people[n]enjoying that work, while others[n]pay to gain happiness.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Those desires are just part of[n]being human. Coming here today[n]has helped me realize that.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Thank you so much for inviting me.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: U-Um, there's one more shop[n]I'm curious about... Is it okay[n]if we go there as well?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It's such a wonderful feeling[n]being able to eat delicious food.
